title: Establish security invariants for architectural refactor seams
description:
Problem: major service decompositions can silently weaken trust boundaries if authorization and approval invariants are not explicit.

Desired outcome: define and enforce invariant checks that must remain true while refactoring architecture hotspots.

Scope:
- In scope: invariant definitions and tests for request guard, role policies, write approval gating, and proposal workflow boundaries.
- Out of scope: net-new business features.

Acceptance criteria:
- Invariant suite exists and runs in local/CI validation.
- Refactor tasks reference these invariants as non-negotiable gates.
- Failing invariants block merge.

Validation:
- Run targeted security and contract tests proving invariants hold before and after extraction slices.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Convergence task created to lock security boundaries before architecture extraction.
